products.description: About the Author R. E. J. Burke is a former U. S. Marine, graduate of the University of Maryland and Yale Graduate School, aeronautical engineer, shipbuilder, banker, entrepreneur, author, and Christian speaker. His passion is the archaeology of the Chalcolithic and early Bronze Age in Western Asia, Eastern Europe, and Northeastern Africa, which led to his writing the six-novel Raising Up Pharaoh epic. Having lived in Asia, South America, the U.S. Midwest and on both coasts, he and his wife, Nancy, now live on the bluffs by the Potomac River in Shepherdstown, West Virginia. They have four adult children and six grandchildren, for whom they are very thankful. His favorite authors are Patrick O'Brian, J. R. R. Tolkien, Charles Dickens, Bernard Cornwell, C. S. Lewis, and Stephen R. Donaldson.

products.description: From the Author I am very excited to have this book finally published! It has taken a long time due to my own moving across the state, building a home and getting resettled in another small town. Thairyn is a wonderful, rascally, regular boy. I love his character, maybe because he reminds me of my own childhood.One thing I know is that I've always wanted a dragon of my own. Maybe more than one. That's why I love fantasy. Dragons fire the imagination with all sorts of possibilities. Were they good or evil? Man killers or friends? What colors were they? Where did they live? Did they hoard treasure or just cause havoc? Come share Thairyn's first real adventure on the magical world of Irth! From the Back Cover Heir to the throne of en'Edlia on the magical world of Irth, Crown Patriarch Thairyn insistently claims that he has a magical birth-gift, even though there is no evidence of it. His family fears he is not just a late bloomer, but magicless like his mother and older sister.The rebellious Xens continue their hostilities against the ruling family members who were born off-world or without magic. When Xens kidnap Thairyn, his frolicking game of "catch-me-if-you-can" turns into a deadly race of "find-me-if-you-can." Will Thairyn be able to overcome his own fear and self-doubt? Will his family be exiled? Will Thairyn escape his kidnappers before they claim the ransom and possibly his life?, p>Unknown to anyone, Thairyn steals a secret that will change all their lives- if there is time for it to unfold amid political and family crisis and the vengeful kidnappers' plot. About the Author A retired reading teacher of 25 years, Nan Whybark loves books and kids and dragons. Putting them all together in one place is what she likes best! Ms. Whybark lives in a small town in Washington state, has five grown children and 20 grandchildren. Read more

The book features a young protagonist named Thairyn who claims to have a magical birth-gift, but there's no evidence of it. He gets kidnapped by rebels and must overcome his fears and self-doubt to escape.

While it's not a graphic novel or historical fiction book, it does have a fantasy setting with magical elements and dragons. If you're interested in fantasy, this might be a good option for you.
